taxaudit

Taxonomic Audit, Character Ontology, and Pairwise Diagnosability

Official CRAN Package: https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=taxaudit

A publication-grade R package for automating the extraction of morphological traits and taxonomic literature auditing from unstructured botanical treatments. It implements controlled ontology mapping, regular expression-based quantitative dimension parsing, benchmark corpus management, and comparative baseline evaluation protocols for biodiversity informatics.

📦 Installation

You can install the official released version of taxaudit directly from CRAN:

install.packages("taxaudit")
If you want to install the latest development version from GitHub:

r # install.packages(“remotes”) remotes::install_github(“AamnaNaveed/taxaudit”) 🚀 Quick Start r library(taxaudit)

Load benchmark corpus & extract traits

corpus <- ta_load_corpus() traits <- ta_extract_traits(corpus$text[1])

Audit agreement & baseline comparison

agreement <- ta_audit_agreement(corpus) comparison <- ta_compare_baseline(corpus)

Leakage-free evaluation

eval_results <- ta_split_evaluation(corpus, split_by = “taxon”) ✨ Features Ontology Mapping: Plant Ontology (PO:0025034) alignment with exact character start/end span tracking.

Agreement Auditing: Inter-annotator agreement auditing (ta_audit_agreement).

Rigorous Validation: Leakage-free taxon-held-out cross-validation (ta_split_evaluation).

Baseline Comparison: Module against naive regex for benchmark evaluation (ta_compare_baseline).

Quality Assured: Fully passes R CMD check with 0 errors | 0 warnings | 0 notes.
